prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square Korean finance article cover, Toss-style large typography and refined dimensional visual. Create an entirely new warm coral and cream cover with a translucent glass piggy bank, a small orderly stream of metallic coins entering it, subtle peach shadows and generous whitespace. Realistic glass/metal rendering, no papercraft, no calendar or cursor. Huge bold Korean title across upper half, verbatim two lines: '청년미래적금' / '월 50만원, 얼마나 더?' Small subtitle: '기여금 6%·12% 쉽게 이해하기'. Do not show19.4% or imply guaranteed return. Only this exact text. Legible mobile thumbnail, no bank/Toss logos, no watermark, one cohesive square image.
